card.headline: Software engineer, 10 years at a B-tier bank technology division under one title; maintains three post-trade systems

bullets_condensed: Maintains the overnight fixed-income settlement batch (about 400,000 trades a night); runtime cut from 6 h to 4.5 h in 2021
Maintains a reference data REST service for about 20 downstream apps; caching cut response time from 180 ms to 95 ms
Maintains the operations reporting portal; Java 8 to 17 upgrade in 2024
Production support one week in five; regulatory field changes; scheduler migration
Rotations in the settlement batch and reporting portal teams; converted to the settlement team

finance.rationale: Bank technology division; no finance role.

general.rationale: Ten years at a B-tier bank technology division under the same title maintaining the same three systems; a few modest numbers (6 h to 4.5 h, 180 ms to 95 ms), no promotion, no leadership, nothing outside work.
top_evidence: Same title (Software Engineer, Associate) from 2016 to 2026
Batch runtime 6 hours to 4.5 hours; cache cut response time 180 ms to 95 ms
Three systems maintained throughout; "meets expectations" reviews

tech.rationale: Senior by years only: a decade of maintenance on three internal systems with no promotion, no ownership beyond a release cycle, and improvements that are modest in scale; the one quantified bullets are real but small.
top_evidence: Ten years, one title, three systems
Java 8 to 17 upgrade; scheduler migration; regulatory field changes
No project, publication or open-source work outside the job

certifications: Oracle Certified Associate, Java SE 8 Programmer

strengths: Ten years of uninterrupted tenure at a B-tier bank technology division
Two measured improvements: batch runtime 6 h to 4.5 h and service response 180 ms to 95 ms
Owns the regression suite (about 600 cases) and the release process for three systems
verdict: Ten years of competent maintenance on three bank systems under one title; the trajectory is flat and the record never leaves the release cycle.
weaknesses: No promotion or title change in ten years
No leadership, mentoring scope or cross-team ownership
No projects, open-source or technical work outside the three systems
